question: Does this generated appcast exactly match the published v2026.7.1 macOS ZIP and pass a previous-stable Sparkle update check?
rationale: The feed is a live release-distribution surface containing artifact-specific signed metadata that repository review cannot safely approve from source shape alone.

options.title: Verify and merge
options.body: Compare every v2026.7.1 enclosure and version field with the published ZIP, run a previous-stable updater smoke check, then merge the generated feed.

options.title: Pause for regeneration
options.body: If any URL, length, signature, build number, or ordering differs, regenerate the appcast from the final published artifact instead of editing it manually.
